description: Surveillance du Sars-Cov-2 dans les eaux usées (SUM'Eau) is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Santé publique France. Ces ressources ne seront plus mises à jour sur data.gouv.fr.\ Vous pouvez les consulter sur Odissé, le portail open data de Santé publique France: - Les mesures: - Les stations: Un dispositif national de surveillance des eaux usées (SUM’Eau) a été initié sous l’impulsion de la direction générale de la santé (Ministère chargé de la ... Coverage: Santé publique France. The portal shows the English title as "Monitoring of Sars-Cov-2 in wastewater (SUM'Eau)" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Santé publique France. Its keywords include sars-cov-2, eau, sumeau, reseau, covid-19. The listing shows 2 download or service links in CSV. The listing shows 2026-01-21 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/licence-ouverte-open-licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
